'''Ladji Ladji''' (Ledji-Ledji) is a [[moribund language|moribund]] [[Australian Aboriginal language]] once widely spoken in [[New South Wales]] and [[Victoria (Australia)|Victoria]] by the [[Latjilatji]] (or Ladji Ladji) people.

Ladji Ladji is part of the [[Kulin languages|Kulin branch]] of the [[Pama–Nyungan languages|Pama–Nyungan]] family of languages, which were spoken by the majority of [[Australian Aborigine|Aboriginal Australian]]s before Australia's colonisation by the [[British Empire]].
